jobs.title: Research Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.jd: Position description At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Research Engineer to join our Data & Agentic team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis and verification engines. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI, advanced agentic workflow and static analysis techniques to complex source code. Your work will directly shape our core products—ensuring both AI-generated and developer-written code meets rigorous enterprise quality and security standards. If you are driven to turn state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you. What you will do Create & Innovate: Actively participate in the conceptualization phase. Brainstorm novel ways to improve our products and provide immediate, practical feedback to steer exploratory research toward paths that are both impactful and engineering-feasible. Develop Agentic Workflows : Design, prototype, and validate intelligent agentic systems and automated workflows that facilitate writing clean code, identifying root causes of system issues, and remediating complex bugs and vulnerabilities. Develop Pragmatic Prototypes: Build hands-on prototypes that prove the viability and scalability of research concepts. Proactively identify engineering bottlenecks or scalability limits and propose effective mitigations early in the research phase. Evaluate & Benchmark: Drive the rigorous evaluation of new product features. Construct high-quality datasets, define relevant success metrics, and implement comprehensive benchmarks leveraging Sonar’s existing IP alongside third-party and open-source AI tools. Engineer Data Pipelines : Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale. Translate Prototypes to Products : Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base. Communicate and Evangelize : Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience and qualifications Must have: Advanced academic background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. Strong software engineering experience (minimum 2+ years in industry) with proficiency in Python and major modern programming languages. Practical experience with modern agentic frameworks, software automation tools, and LLM architectures. Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy. Hands-on experience integrating third-party tools, program analysis frameworks, or open-source libraries into functional prototypes. Proven experience in data handling: constructing high-quality datasets, defining objective success metrics, and building robust benchmarks for new solutions. The ability to fast context-switch and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent, fast-moving research topics. Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads. Plus: Background in static analysis: abstract syntax trees (ASTs), code security, bug detection, etc.. Familiarity with LLM techniques such as model fine-tuning, semantic search engines, etc. Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS). Additional comments This role is based in Bochum. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Content Intelligence
jobs.jd: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. The Verbatim squad sits within the Enrichment & Content Intelligence product area and is focused on helping Spotify better understand audio, text, and visual content through machine learning. The team develops technologies that power experiences across Spotify including content skipping, transcription, moderation, and visual understanding. Working at the intersection of large-scale machine learning and product innovation, the squad partners closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to build intelligent systems that improve how users experience content across the platform. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end machine learning initiatives from ideation and prototyping through experimentation, deployment, and large-scale productionization. Design, develop, and deploy machine learning systems that operate across hundreds of millions of content signals using both real-time and batch processing architectures. Advance Spotify’s capabilities in natural language understanding, multimodal AI, and content intelligence. Build and evaluate LLM-powered solutions using modern prompting techniques, retrieval systems, and advanced model orchestration approaches. Define rigorous evaluation methodologies including golden datasets, precision and recall frameworks, offline benchmarking, and online experimentation. Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and Data Scientists to influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions. Mentor engineers across the organization and help elevate machine learning engineering standards and best practices. Contribute to the adoption of AI-assisted development workflows and tooling that improve team productivity and engineering effectiveness. Who You Are You have solid experience developing and deploying machine learning systems in production environments. You have successfully delivered large-scale machine learning architectures operating on substantial datasets and high-throughput production systems. You have deep experience with machine learning, deep learning, and modern AI technologies. You have hands-on experience working with large language models and understand how to evaluate, adapt, and deploy them effectively for real-world product challenges. You have experience building evaluation frameworks and can quantify model performance through robust experimentation and measurement techniques. You know how to navigate ambiguity and make thoughtful technical trade-offs that balance product impact, scalability, and engineering quality. You have experience influencing technical direction across cross-functional teams and can communicate complex machine learning concepts to diverse audiences. You care about developing others and enjoy mentoring engineers through technical guidance and collaboration. You have experience working with NLP, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, or multimodal machine learning systems. You are curious about emerging AI technologies and excited about integrating tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI-assisted development capabilities into engineering workflows. Where You'll Be This role is based in London or Stockholm. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app. This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams. What You Will Build Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems. Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows. Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence. Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production. Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust. Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale. What We Look For Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience. Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools. Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack. Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not. Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time. Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus. This Role Is Not For People who only want research projects with no production ownership. Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems. Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact. People who overclaim AI impact without evidence. Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams. The Bar We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Gateway (Machine Learning)
jobs.jd: Are you ready to unlock intelligence? If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. The Mission The AI Gateway team is on a mission to build the central nervous system for the agentic era, enabling developers to securely and reliably connect, observe, and manage their AI and ML services at scale. Some of the gateway’s more advanced capabilities, such as intelligent model routing, semantic caching, request classification, and content guardrails, work best when backed by small, purpose-built models. In this role you will build those features end to end: the gateway code that runs them in the request path, and the models behind them. What You’ll Do Own the technical direction for model-backed AI Gateway features, from design to production rollout. Build and maintain high-performance components for Kong ’s AI Gateway in Rust and Lua. Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models for specific gateway use cases, such as classifiers for intelligent routing, embeddings for semantic caching, and guardrail models. Curate and maintain the datasets used for training and evaluation, and define the metrics and thresholds that decide whether a model is good enough to ship. Integrate models into the gateway request path, optimizing inference for latency, throughput, and memory footprint. Troubleshoot bugs, tune performance, and do low-level optimizations across both the gateway and the model serving stack. Work with product management and other engineering teams to turn model capabilities into reliable, documented product features. Mentor other engineers on the team on ML practices and model integration. What You’ll Bring The Toolkit 3+ years of experience in server-side software development: building and debugging applications that are highly scalable, distributed, reliable and resilient. 2+ years of experience in machine learning: building, training and evaluating models for production or research. Proficiency with tensor-based deep learning frameworks, in Python and beyond. Experience with dataset curation and evaluation methodology. Experience running models in production outside of Python, optimizing inference for latency and memory (e.g. ONNX Runtime, quantization, batching). Working knowledge of embeddings and vector databases. Hands-on expertise with Linux systems. The Kong DNA Ownership: You take full ownership of your work from concept to production, including the documentation: engineers at Kong write the documentation for their products. Pragmatism: You can tell when a model is the right tool and when a simpler solution is, and you measure before you decide. Collaboration: You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively with a remotely distributed team. Leadership: You make and explain technical trade-offs where there is no established playbook. Bonus Points Contributions to open-source software projects. Proficiency in Rust, Lua or C. Familiarity with the Rust ML ecosystem (e.g. Candle, Burn, tokenizers). Experience with MLOps tooling and pipelines for training, versioning, and deploying models. Experience with experiment tracking tools (e.g. MLflow, Weights & Biases). Experience with LLM post-training techniques such as LoRA or other parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods. Knowledge of networking fundamentals and protocols on both L4 and L7 (TCP/IP, HTTP/2, gRPC). Hands-on experience with NGINX and OpenResty. About Kong : Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong ’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. jobs.jd: ABOUT US At Contáctica , we are our clients' evolution partner. We connect technology, data, creativity, and paid, owned, and earned channels to deliver measurable business results. We seek curious, proactive, and collaborative individuals who integrate artificial intelligence into their daily work to transform operations, processes, and challenges into valuable solutions. Experience working with REST APIs, authentication, pagination, rate limits, and incremental data loading. Practical understanding of machine learning, including data preparation, the differences between training and inference, basic evaluation metrics, and data leakage prevention. Experience working in GitHub with a branch and pull request workflow, writing clear context in PRs and issues, and using AI coding assistants such as Cursor as part of daily work. Sufficient English proficiency to work with technical documentation. VALUED Knowledge of statistical fundamentals and experience with predictive models, propensity modeling, or Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM). Apply here and start the journey. Please include a personal letter with your application explaining why you're the best person for this position. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Policy & Safety
jobs.jd: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. The Policy & Safety team sits within Content Platform in the Experience Mission, building the systems that keep Spotify safe, compliant, and trusted by millions of users and creators. This team owns Spotify’s content moderation infrastructure — from detection models to policy enforcement systems and compliance data pipelines. Working at the intersection of machine learning, platform engineering, and regulatory compliance, the team partners closely with Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs. They’re on the critical path for every new content type and social feature — including messaging, comments, and collaborative experiences — ensuring safety is built in from day one. jobs.title: Chemical Data Scientist
jobs.jd: About Valdera : At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly. Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you. Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together. Role Description: We are hiring a C hemical Data Scientist to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform. Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database. You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on. Role Responsibilities: Design and build pipelines to collect supplier data and chemical product information (specifications, CAS numbers, certifications, SDS/regulatory documents, NAICS classification of manufacturing plants) from supplier sites, distributor catalogs, trade databases, and other public and semi-structured sources Develop and maintain web scrapers and automated ETL workflows to keep supplier and product data current at scale Clean, normalize, and reconcile inconsistent supplier data into structured, standardized formats suitable for internal tools and analytics Apply chemical domain knowledge to validate and enrich data — resolving product names, CAS numbers, synonyms, and specifications across suppliers Evaluate and improve matching and classification models to map suppliers and products to buyer requirements, and to identify overlapping or equivalent chemical offerings Partner with Supplier Management and Engineering to define data quality standards, identify gaps in supplier coverage, and prioritize new data sources. Own pipeline health and data quality, and drive the KPIs that measure overall data coverage Experience & Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in a data science, data engineering, or applied data role, ideally with exposure to messy, real-world or industrial datasets. Working knowledge of chemistry or chemical industry data — comfort with CAS numbers, chemical properties, SDS documents, NAICS classification, and supplier certifications Strong Python skills, with experience building web scrapers and data pipelines Experience with data cleaning and normalization at scale, and a good eye for spotting inconsistencies in unstructured data Familiarity with building or applying matching, deduplication, or classification models (traditional ML or LLM-based approaches) Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to accelerate data extraction, enrichment, or engineering workflows Startup mindset with a strong sense of ownership — comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, remote environment with ambiguous, evolving priorities Compensation Additional Information Salary Range: Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role. Benefits: Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera. Equal Opportunity Employer Statement: Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - Tokyo
jobs.jd: About the Team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems. About the Role You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions. You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground. You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it. This role is based in Tokyo. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role you will: - Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria. - Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review. - Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates. - Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence. - Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software. - Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering. - Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows. - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security. - Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes. - Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders. Additional experience includes: Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas: - Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment. - Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners. - Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities. - Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases. - Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior. - Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust. - Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research. - Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be admin

jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, TX, Austin US, NC, Remote US, TX, Remote US, NY, Remote US, NC, Durham
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to develop our core libraries for Agentic Applications. Are you excited by the prospect of building foundational technology that powers the next generation of agents? Have you ever dreamed of elevating engineering practices to enable the safe and scalable deployment of autonomous systems? As a global leader in AI and deep learning, NVIDIA is redefining industries and our work in agentic computing is at the forefront of this revolution. Join us in building the scalable agentic capabilities, reusable building blocks, and high-quality libraries that will accelerate developer productivity, ensure agent quality, and provide critical acceleration and optimization for highly performant and efficient agents. Work directly with a community of creative engineers and collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in the world of autonomous agents! What you'll be doing: Track and understand evolving agent development patterns across NVIDIA and the broader ecosystem, maintaining current knowledge of both research and commercial products. Develop open-source libraries and tools which accelerate and optimize agent harnesses and frameworks ensuring top-tier performance, accuracy, quality, and stability. Benchmark the latest agents to identify bottlenecks and build creative solutions to increase performance, reduce cost, and improve latency. Work closely with teams building high-performance data pipelines, RAG systems, vector databases, and GPU-optimized training and inference workflows to deliver best-in-class agentic applications. Identify gaps and friction in current agent architectures, and translate insights into agentic tools that boosts developer velocity and agent quality—backed by evaluations, benchmarking, and feedback loops. What we need to see: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 8+ years experience in at least one of Rust, Python, Go, or Node.js, with working familiarity in at least one more. Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, callbacks, request lifecycles, and event-driven systems. Hands-on experience with evolving agent architectures, multiple agents frameworks and agent harnesses. Proficiency in LLM applications, agent workflows, tool calls, and model-provider APIs. Ability to design or extend cross-language APIs with attention to consistency, usability, stability, and backwards compatibility. Systems-level debugging and performance intuition: able to trace execution from high-level API calls through runtime internals, language bindings, callbacks, serialization, and event emission to understand overhead and optimize hot paths. Strong interpersonal skills, enabling direct contact and effective collaboration with the open source community. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience building evaluation/benchmarking systems for agent workflows (metrics, regression, feedback loops). Rust systems work, especially async Rust, Tokio, serde, API design, or runtime state management and /or Python native extension experience with PyO3, maturin, or Python/Rust bindings. Instrumenting third-party frameworks without changing user-visible behavior. Knowledge of OpenTelemetry, tracing, structured events, exporters, or observability pipelines are a plus. Middleware, plugin systems, guardrails, policy engines, or request/response interception and maintaining open-source libraries, SDKs, or internal developer platforms. Profiling or optimizing runtime/library overhead across language boundaries, async execution, native bindings, serialization, tracing, or middleware pipelines. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 23, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Evisort AI
jobs.jd: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team Join the Evisort AI team at Workday, which powers Document Intelligence AI and Workday's CLM and Contract Intelligence offerings. Our mission is to change the way business deals get done. We build ground breaking AI technology that can read and understand contract language to make every part of the deal-making process from drafting, negotiating, reviewing, approving, or managing the contracts happen faster, better, with reduced risks. We build AI first products, and automate manual work, freeing up our customers time and accelerating their businesses. You will be joining the Evisort AI team, which functions as a startup within Workday. This is your opportunity to build at the pace of innovation of a startup, while backed by the enormous support and impacting Workday's incredible customer base of 70M+ users. About the Role As an AI Engineer, you will help develop tailored user experiences using advanced LLMs, Knowledge Graphs, personalization, and predictive analysis. You will collaborate with other engineers to deliver AI solutions across Workday's product ecosystem and utilize software and data engineering stacks to enable training, deployment, and lifecycle management of various AI pipelines. You will develop and deploy new products at scale and leverage Workday's vast computing resources on rich datasets to deliver transformative value to our customers. In addition to contributing to feature and service development, you must have an approach of continuous improvement, passion for quality, scale, and security. You must be curious and prepared to question or challenge choices and practices where they don't make sense to you or could be improved. You also should have a product approach and strong intuition around how AI can drive a better customer experience. Lastly, a strong sense of ownership and teamwork are essential to succeed in this role. jobs.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, AWS Applied AI Solutions - Life Sciences
jobs.jd: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. The Team Join the next science revolution at AWS Life Sciences Applied AI Solutions where you'll work alongside world-class scientists to build AI that transforms how therapeutics are discovered, developed, and brought to patients. We're out to revolutionize how medicines are discovered, developed, and brought to patients powered by a new generation of AI. Our team tackles some of the hardest open problems at the intersection of frontier AI and life sciences. We apply biological foundation models large language models and agentic reasoning systems to life sciences problems then put them into the hands of customers as applications and managed services they can fine-tune tailor and deploy on their own data. The science challenges are deep: how do you design agentic systems that reason correctly over complex biological regulatory and clinical logic? How do you enable customers to tailor foundation models to their proprietary data and get better outputs with less effort? How do you adapt models to reason faithfully in high-stakes scientific and regulatory domains? Today we're focused on two areas. In clinical trials we're building AI that automates and optimizes regulatory and clinical development workflows. In drug design our products (including Amazon Bio Discovery) accelerate discovery by giving bench scientists AI-guided protein engineering and antibody design capabilities. We combine frontier research with production-scale delivery to put breakthrough science into the hands of customers solving humanity's hardest problems. We value scientific rigor encourage publication and support conference participation. If you want to do research that ships this is the team. The Role We are seeking an Applied Scientist to build the models and methods behind our life sciences AI products with a primary focus on clinical trial operations and agentic reasoning. You will design train and evaluate systems that reason over complex clinical and operational logic and ship them into products customers use directly. You will work closely with senior and principal scientists on well-scoped research problems own your results end to end and see your work reach production. This role combines expertise in LLM reasoning and agentic AI with applied impact in life sciences. You will work on how large language models reason plan and act in complex scientific domains while applying domain knowledge to ensure models produce scientifically valid outputs. The problems span multiple fronts: • How do you build LLM-based agentic systems that correctly reason over clinical protocols regulatory standards and complex multi-step operational workflows? • How do you evaluate agent reliability and faithfulness rigorously enough to trust in high-stakes clinical settings? • How do you develop model customization methods (fine-tuning retrieval augmentation domain adaptation) that let customers get strong results from foundation models on their own data? You will focus on clinical trial operations (agentic automation structured reasoning evaluation domain adaptation) with opportunities to contribute across drug discovery (protein engineering antibody design) as the portfolio grows. You will own end-to-end scientific solutions from research through production and your work will directly shape the tools that scientists use daily. Key job responsibilities • Design train fine-tune and evaluate LLM-based agentic systems that reason over clinical protocols regulatory standards and operational workflows • Build rigorous evaluation harnesses and benchmarks to measure agent reliability faithfulness and failure modes in high-stakes domains • Develop model customization methods (fine-tuning RLHF retrieval augmentation domain adaptation) that help customers get better outputs on their own data with less effort • Contribute to graph-based and causal modeling approaches for clinical trial operations • Partner with Life Sciences domain experts product and engineering to translate scientific challenges into shipped capabilities • Own experiments end to end: problem framing implementation evaluation iteration and hand-off to production • Publish at top-tier venues where the work supports it • Contribute to drug discovery efforts (protein engineering antibody design) as opportunities arise A day in the life • Design and run an experiment to validate a new agentic reasoning or fine-tuning method then ship it as a capability customers can use • Diagnose why a model is failing on a new class of inputs and implement a fix to unblock a delivery milestone • Build or extend an evaluation benchmark to measure how faithfully an agent reasons over clinical logic • Meet with domain experts to scope what the next model release needs to do • Review results with a senior scientist sharpen the approach and get it over the finish line • Prototype a new idea that could become the next capability in the product About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer, Agentic Systems Intelligence
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 30 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIA N, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. We are looking for outstanding Senior AI Researchers & Engineers to join NVIDIA 's Agentic Systems Intelligence (ASI) team, a frontier research and engineering team advancing high-performance AI. Our team builds the next generation of agentic AI systems for the CUDA ecosystem, working across the full stack—from training and improving models, to designing agent architectures and multi-agent systems, to building the systems, runtimes, and evaluation frameworks that make them effective at scale. You will investigate open-ended research questions and turn promising ideas into working systems that can reason about, generate, optimize, and operate across NVIDIA 's accelerated computing stack. Depending on your strengths and interests, your work may focus on advancing model and agent capabilities, building scalable agent systems and runtimes, or developing high-fidelity training and evaluation environments. You will own significant parts of these systems end to end and collaborate closely with NVIDIA software, model, and hardware teams to bring new capabilities into NVIDIA products. What you'll be doing: Research, build, and optimize agentic AI systems for the CUDA ecosystem, including agent architectures, multi-agent workflows, tool use, memory, and orchestration. Build the data pipelines, environments, verification tools, reward mechanisms, and evaluation frameworks needed to continuously improve model and agent capabilities through rigorous experimentation. Co-design and optimize agentic systems across NVIDIA 's software and hardware stack, from models and inference through compilers, runtimes, libraries, kernels, and GPUs. Demonstrate measurable improvements in correctness, performance, or developer productivity. Take ideas from research prototype to production: own technical directions end to end, set a high bar for rigor, and work with partner teams to deliver them into NVIDIA products. What we need to see: Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 6+ years of relevant industry or research experience (including PhD research) in AI systems, agentic AI, machine learning, reinforcement learning, compilers, high-performance computing, or computer architecture. Hands-on research or development experience in agent systems, coding agents, model training, reinforcement learning, or modern AI inference systems. Strong Python programming skills and proficiency in C/C++ or Rust, with solid software engineering fundamentals. Experience with GPU programming and performance optimization using CUDA or comparable accelerator platforms, and the ability to work effectively across system boundaries. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd: PhD research in a relevant area, with demonstrated ability to formulate research questions, build working implementations, and evaluate them rigorously. Track record of building high-impact coding agents, autonomous software-engineering systems, developer tools, or agent training and evaluation environments. Hands-on experience with GPU performance optimization, or with optimizing and deploying on TRT-LLM, SGLang, vLLM, or Transformer Engine. Evidence of technical depth and ownership through impactful research prototypes, deployed systems, benchmark results, or substantial open-source contributions. Relevant publications are welcome; we especially value strong engineering and measurable real-world impact. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and hardworking people in the world working with us and our product lines are growing fast in some of the hottest state of the art fields such as Virtual Reality, Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Autonomous Vehicles. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 187,500 USD – 364,000 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 21, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Le contexte Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, la squad Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage. Tirer parti de la jurimétrie et des simulations existantes pour apporter du contexte et des suggestions personnalisées autour d’une simulation de rupture de contrat de travail. Étudier le développement d’un chatbot spécialisé sur la plateforme Jobexit. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the Role We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to make our systems work reliably in real-world deployed environments, not just in controlled engineering settings. This role closes the gap between Engineering, Product, Operations, Customer Success, and the customer — owning technical execution in the field, catching issues early, and turning field reality into clear engineering action. You'll need to be comfortable operating across domains rather than as a single-discipline specialist: reasoning practically across software, electronics, hardware, comms, and operations, and diagnosing issues with whatever time, tools, and backup are actually available onsite. Expect regular travel and field time, hands-on work outside a narrow job description, and close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Customer Success. What you will do Own technical execution in the field — deploying, troubleshooting, and supporting systems in real-world environments outside the lab. Diagnose and resolve issues across domains without needing everything translated by specialists, using structured fault-finding under real-world time and resource constraints. Prepare for deployments and field activity — checklists, spares, tools, documentation, and readiness checks — to make field operations faster and more repeatable. Capture and translate field observations into clear engineering feedback, closing the gap between what's built, what's deployed, and what the customer needs. Support demonstrations, trials, and customer-facing technical activity, representing the technical team credibly in front of customers and operators. jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist , Amazon Leo Networking Software
jobs.jd: Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite broadband network to deliver fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world, including those underserved by traditional infrastructure. Operating a live constellation and its ground network at scale means service disruptions are an inevitable reality, and how quickly we detect them, understand them, and prevent them from recurring defines the trust we earn as a connectivity provider. We are seeking a talented Senior Data Scientist to build the next generation of observability and availability science for the Leo network. Leo already detects outages, notifies affected customers, and restores service. The frontier is prediction and prevention: reasoning over complex network and ground-segment telemetry to autonomously detect anomalies before they reach customers, attribute root cause automatically across a sprawling event surface, and rationalize a large, still-maturing metric set so responders trust what the system tells them. In this role you will work backwards from the needs of customers and operations teams. You will own the scientific direction end to end, partnering closely with network engineers, the Network Operations Center, and the Incident Management team, and the Software and Networking orginization to translate a long-term science vision into concrete research and delivery roadmaps. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities * Own the observability and availability science end to end, from long-term vision to research roadmap to production delivery, working backwards from the needs of customers, the NOC, and network engineering. * Develop time-series and graph-based models with dynamic baselining that detect network and ground-segment anomalies before they cross the High Severity threshold, enabling proactive investigation rather than reactive response. * Reason over complex, multi-system telemetry to attribute cause automatically during live HSEs and LSEs, so Call Leaders and engineers spend time mitigating, not hunting. * Provide the science behind the network's bucketed availability decomposition (geometric and satellite coverage, ground and network segments, customer terminals, payload, and planning), attributing every movement to a true cause rather than noise, so leadership steers on signal and engineering effort lands where it actually moves availability and throughput. * Deliver the models, analyses, and metrics that feed the daily system readiness and validation review consumed by senior leadership and product and engineering, turning availability and throughput data into a defensible, evidence-based read on progress against GA entry criteria. * Own the recurring, fleet-wide "hot topic" investigations that span ASIC, firmware, payload, network, and planning, separating correlated symptoms from true root cause across thousands of nodes, quantifying how much availability or throughput each is costing, and answering whether it is a launch-blocking risk and whether it is improving. * Deliver alert correlation and deduplication, false-positive reduction, and metric-quality scoring so responders trust what the system tells them, directly supporting a large, still-maturing KPI set. * Tie your science to the unit the org actually measures: reduce detection and attribution time, raise availability against the network's bar, and increase the share of events prevented before customer impact. * Partner day to day with the Network Operations Center, Network Engineering, and the Incident Management (Call Leader) program; sit on live HSE/LSE bridges as the science partner and turn event learnings into model improvements. * Feed COEs and RCAs back into detection and attribution so recurring signatures are caught earlier, and help design and score gamedays that stress-test both the network and your models against real, closed events. * Build and deploy production pipelines on AWS (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, Glue) with model validation, monitoring, drift detection, and explainability, because operations teams must be able to trust and act on model output under pressure. * Set data-science standards, mentor scientists, and drive best practices across the Leo networking organization as the science function scales. * Produce explainable output and written narratives that let responders and leaders three or more levels up act on your models during and between events. A day in the life You might start by reviewing overnight anomaly detections and availability movements, join an HSE bridge as the science partner by midday, and spend the afternoon refining root-cause attribution models or presenting availability findings at the readiness review. About the team Amazon Leo Networking Software builds and operates the software behind Leo's satellite and ground network. Our science function partners with the NOC, Network Engineering and Incident Management to make the network more available and resilient, moving from reacting to outages to predicting and preventing them. As a Data Scientist III, you'll help shape that function as it grows. - 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience - 4+ years of data scientist experience - Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression - 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience - Experience managing data pipelines - Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.jd:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join the Detection subdomain within Trust & Safety, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community by identifying harmful content and activities. We build detection capabilities that enable timely prevention and moderation, reducing members’ exposure to harm, while minimising disruption to legitimate members.

You’ll develop and improve machine learning models that identify harmful listings and suspicious behaviour across the marketplace, while minimising friction on legitimate members. Working with text, images and behavioural data, you’ll apply practical machine learning techniques to evolving detection challenges.

You’ll work closely with Data Scientists, Decision Scientists, Product Managers and engineers to turn ideas into reliable production solutions. You’ll take ownership of well-defined projects across the ML lifecycle, from understanding the data and developing models to deployment, evaluation and ongoing maintenance.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Develop, evaluate and improve machine learning models that detect harmful content and behaviour at scale.
  • Engineer features, prepare training and evaluation datasets, understanding their limitations and addressing issues such as noisy labels, class imbalance and data leakage.
  • Collaborate with engineers to integrate models into production and develop reliable training and inference pipelines using established tooling.
  • Work with Decision Scientists and Product Managers to define success metrics and evaluate model improvements through offline analysis and online experimentation, balancing detection coverage with false positives and member experience.
  • Monitor deployed models, investigate changes in their effectiveness and improve them as harmful behaviour and underlying data evolve.
  • Write reliable, maintainable and reproducible code, document your work, share learnings and contribute ideas to the team’s roadmap.

About you 

  • Practical experience developing machine learning solutions, with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistics and probability theory.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn or PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience preparing training datasets, engineering features, training models and evaluating them against baselines and metrics.
  • Experience applying machine learning to at least one of the following: tabular or behavioural data, natural language processing, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with the production ML lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring and retraining.
  • Ability to break down problems into manageable steps, work independently within an agreed scope and seek input when needed.
  • Ability to communicate your approach, findings and trade-offs clearly, collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues, and learn from feedback.
  • Motivation to apply machine learning to member safety, with care for data privacy and the consequences of incorrect predictions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud detection, content classification or other Trust & Safety applications.
  • Experience with transformers, multimodal models or LLM-based workflows.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.jd: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. ABOUT RAMP LABS Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research and engineering group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000+ companies use to move money. ABOUT THE ROLE Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet. You'll design and run those systems: how work gets split, how agents coordinate, how results get deduplicated, verified and ranked, and what it all costs. The problems are general (agent swarms, agentic map-reduce, long-running fan-out workflows) and you'll own them from prototype to production. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Decide how the work gets done: how to break a problem down, what each agent sees, how many agents to run, and which model handles which step - Squeeze accuracy out of the models: context design, self-verification, voting and consensus across agents, and knowing when more agents stop helping - Measure quality without reading every trace: sampling, automated verification, and precision and recall on the final output - Drive down cost and latency per useful result: model routing, caching, early stopping, and smaller or fine-tuned models where they hold up - Turn one-off experiments into reusable workflows on our existing orchestration stack - Evaluate new models, inference setups and training approaches, and bring in what works WHAT YOU NEED - Experience building applied AI systems and LLM applications that shipped - Hands-on experience with multi-agent or high-fan-out LLM workloads: parallel agents, map-reduce over models, large batch inference - Strong engineering in Python; you build concurrent, distributed systems that hold up in production - Judgment about output: you decide what the end result should look like before you scale the swarm, and you can separate signal from agent noise - The habit of measuring: cost, yield, false-positive rate, and whether a change actually helped - Ownership: you can run a roadmap and a production system with little oversight - Clear written communication NICE-TO-HAVE - Built agent orchestration or job systems (Ray, Temporal, Modal or custom) - Used LLMs to search large spaces: codebases, document sets, logs or other large corpora - Post-training or hosting open-source models for high-volume inference - Distributed systems background - Public work we can look at: an agent framework, an open-source project, a write-up or a paper BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL) - Flexible PTO - Centralized home-office equipment ordering - Health and wellness stipend - Budget for intra-office travel - Weekly coffee stipend UNITED STATES - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents - One Medical annual membership - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay - jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.

In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do

  • Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.
  • Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.
  • Design, implement and review GraphQL and REST APIs and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients.
  • Improve and extend automated testing (RSpec and other frameworks) to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.
  • Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
  • Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
  • Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, including background jobs, APIs and data models.
  • Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.
  • Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.
  • Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.
  • Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.
  • Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.
  • Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

About the team

The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution, they provide the core harness for GitLab’s agents, the tools Agent’s need to interact with GitLab as well as ways to configure and execute Agents across GitLab.

Our engineers work async-first across EMEA and AMER timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders

jobs.title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers. De uitdaging Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers , zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken. Je werk bestaat onder meer uit: Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen. Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining. Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning. Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden. Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap. Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als ontwikkelaar, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met AI en machine learning. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras. Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI. Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn. Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow. Je kunt onderbouwen welk model of welke tool in welke situatie het beste werkt, en je maakt je nieuwe tools snel eigen. Je volgt generatieve AI op de voet, van prompt via context naar harness engineering, en weet hoe je oplossingen met LLM’s evalueert, monitort en verbetert. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling. Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je gemaakte assignment, ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Raoel via Over ons LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past. Rethink it with LINKIT. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: AI Engineer - RL Post-Training and Agentic Systems
jobs.jd: About us We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies. Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture.
